test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

I have ______ to understand your problem.
solution:
The correct answer is **"begun."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We can see that the given sentence is in the** Present Perfect Tense.**
 
• **Structure: Subject + Has/have + V3 + Object**
 
 
• **Example: ***I **have completed**__ my work.*
 
 
 
• **"Begun"** is the past participle form of the verb **"begin".**
 
• In this sentence, the speaker is saying that they have started the process of understanding the problem.
 
• **"Begun"** is the correct option because it is in the present perfect tense, which is used to describe actions that started in the past and continue into the present.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *I have __**begun**__ to understand your problem.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"beginning"**, is a noun and cannot be used as a verb in this sentence.
 
• Option 2, **"began"**, is the past tense form of **"begin" **and does not fit grammatically with** "have".**
 
• Option 3,** "begin",** is the base form of the verb and does not fit grammatically with **"have". **
